reject_wait_short: ⏳ You need to wait a bit longer before submitting another report.
reject_cooldown:
⏳ **Reporting temporarily unavailable**

Your last report was **rejected with a penalty** (deliberate **false** report / troll / obvious abuse). You can use **`/reportbug`** again after **{until}** (Paris time).

**Good-faith** reports that turn out not to be bugs are handled **without** this penalty.
daily:
📅 **Daily limit reached**

You already sent a report **today** (Paris timezone). One report per day — **one bug** at a time. Try again **tomorrow after midnight**.
blacklist:
🚫 **Bug reporting disabled**

You no longer have access to the bug reporting system.
modal_repro_ph: If you can’t reproduce, explain why (≥12 characters).
hint_cmd: Say **which command or system** is affected (this field can stay short, e.g. `/quiz`).
hint_total: The **total** text must be at least **{min}** characters (all fields combined).
hint_fields: The **observed issue**, **expected behaviour** and **reproduction steps** fields must each be at least **{min}** characters. The **command / system** field can stay short.
preview_footer: One bug per report — check before sending.
draft_expired: ⏱️ This draft expired. Run **`/reportbug`** again from a server.
save_fail: ❌ Could not save the report right now. Try again later.
embed_footer_owner: 🔍 Dismissed = not a bug, no penalty · ✖️ Reject = troll/deliberate false (7d) · ✅ Confirm (bug/translation) = XP
owner_dm_fail: ❌ The owner could not be reached by **DM** right now. Your report was **not** saved. Try again later.
sent_ok: ✅ **Report sent** to the owner. You’ll get a reply in **DMs** once it’s processed.
report_gone: This report is no longer pending (already handled or not found).
dismiss_body:
Thanks for your feedback — it was **read and reviewed**.

In this case it **wasn’t a bot bug** in the sense of something to fix for a reward: e.g. **bot restart**, **AniList API** temporarily down, **already fixed** behaviour, or an **extremely rare** case.

**No penalty** applies: you can keep using **`/reportbug`** normally (subject to the daily limit).

_The **7-day** penalty only applies to **deliberate** false reports (troll / obvious abuse)._
dismiss_edit: **Dismissed** — not a real bug, **no penalty** (user notified).
refuse_body:
Your report was **rejected with a penalty**: it was a **deliberate false** report, **troll** or **obvious abuse** (not an honest mistake).

You can’t use **`/reportbug`** for **7 days**.

_Serious reports that aren’t bugs (API, restart, etc.) are handled **without** this penalty._
pending_only: This report is no longer pending.
validation_hint: Choose the **type** (bug or translation), **severity**, and whether it was **hard to find**, then **Grant reward**.
pick_sev_hard: Choose **severity** and whether the bug was **hard to find** before validating.
confirm_user_line1_translation: Your **translation / typo** report was validated and fixed.
confirm_user_thanks: Thanks for helping improve the bot!
intro_body:
Thanks for helping improve the bot.

• **One issue per report** — don’t mix several problems.
• You can report a **bug**, a **translation issue**, or a **typo**.
• **One report per day** (resets at midnight, Paris time).
• In case of **abuse** (deliberate **false** reports / troll), the owner may apply a **7-day rejection penalty**. **Good-faith** feedback that turns out not to be a bug (API, restart, etc.) is handled **without** that penalty.

Click **Write my report**: a form will ask for:
• the command or system;
• what you observed;
• expected behaviour;
• steps to reproduce (or why it can’t be reproduced).

Then check the preview and send with **Send report**.
dm_blocked:
🔒 **Can’t open your report**

Your **DMs** are closed or the bot can’t message you.

**Enable DMs** (Settings → Privacy → direct messages) so the bot can send the form **privately**. This avoids posting a bug in the server and duplicate copy-paste reports.

There is **no** channel posting: everything goes through DMs.
dm_sent_hint: 📬 **Check your DMs** — the bot sent the next steps to write your report.
